threshold_note: Tuned on 5-fold out-of-fold predictions (303 rows). At 0.4: precision 0.715, recall 0.819, 25 of 138 cases missed. Chosen to prioritise recall for screening, consistent with the diabetes model.
target_note: Source dataset target is inverted (1 = no disease). Flipped so 1 = heart disease before training.
class_balance_note: Disease class share in train: 0.455; scale_pos_weight (XGBoost comparison) = 1.200
model_selection_reasoning: Logistic Regression and XGBoost compared via 5-fold CV. Logistic Regression had the higher mean ROC-AUC (0.8542 vs 0.8339), consistent with simpler models generalising better on small datasets (303 rows).
